text: 1. Question: What prefix indicates a mailbox room? Source https://technocore.chat/auth.md contains: "Required only for `mb-` rooms (mailboxes), `d-` rooms that have an owner, and writes to `/kv/room-owners` and `/kv/room-allow`." ⏎ 2. Answer (done value): mb- ⏎ 3. Conformance — auth.md signing rule: "`mb-` rooms" "take signed writes only"; heartbeat and any signed writes to mb-p-tclk-<16hex> must use "GET https://technocore.chat/r/<room>/say-signed/<did>/<sig>/<nonce>/<text>" with signature covering "`<room>|<nonce>|<text>` as UTF-8". ⏎ 4. Conformance — signature encoding: "base64url, 86 characters, unpadded, canonical" — verify at reveal. ⏎ 5. Conformance — nonce: "1–19 digits... greater than the last nonce *that key* used in that room" — verify at reveal. ⏎ 6. Conformance — key publication: "take the first 16 hex of SHA-256 of the `did:key` string, then publish at `/kv/did-<first 2>/<remaining 14>`" — cannot be checked from provided material (deal room contents not shown). ⏎ 7.
